items.reason: Default scopeProviders now [.timed, .timeLimit, .exclusive, .snapshot]; Package.swift: target 'Tests Performance' gains a dependency on target 'Tests Snapshot' (no cycle). Test.Trait.Snapshot now stores the whole Test.Snapshot.Configuration (init(configuration:) added, init(recording:) kept, recording is now a computed property), and the .snapshot provider installs that configuration, so .snapshots(configuration:) keeps snapshotDirectory/subdirectory under the runner, not only the recording mode.

items.item: `Sources/Tests Inline Snapshot/snapshot.swift`: `.all` passes for a file-backed snapshot but
items.reason: Chose the file-backed semantics for both paths (existing tests pin file-backed .missing-records-and-passes): inline .all, .missing with no expected value, and .failed with no expected value now register the recording and pass instead of failing with 'Recorded inline snapshot. Re-run to assert.'; .failed mismatch still registers and fails, .never still fails. The generic named: overloads (sync and async) now pass config.subdirectory to Storage.resolve.

items.item: `Sources/Tests Reporter/Test.Reporter.JSON.swift`: the JSON reporter does not escape strings

api_changes: Test.Trait.Snapshot: new public stored property configuration and init(configuration:); recording changed from stored let to computed var (source compatible).
Inline snapshot(...) results: recording under .all/.missing/.failed-without-value now passes instead of failing (behaviour change).
JSON reporter output is now swift-json pretty output ({"events": [...]}, keys unchanged); elapsed_ns now includes whole seconds (it previously dropped them: attoseconds/1e9 only).
notes: No uses of Test.Trait.Snapshot, scopeProviders or Test.Reporter.json(to:) outside swift-tests in /home/user/cloud-workspace/repos. Tests: Test.Runner Tests.swift (modifier configuration reaches the body under the default runner), Test.Snapshot.assert Tests.swift (inline/file .all parity, inline .missing passes, generic .data named snapshot lands under the configured subdirectory; all paths under /tmp/swift-tests-unit), new Test.Reporter.JSON Tests.swift (uses @testable import Tests_Reporter for the new internal Test.Reporter.jsonDocument(for:)/jsonRecord(for:)).
